About the Position

This dual-award PhD project will investigate how environmental factors influence the evolution of antimicrobial resistance across Manchester and Peking University.

OpportunityFully Funded PhD Studentship: Environmental Controls on Antimicrobial Resistance (Dual-Degree)
HostUniversity of Manchester
LocationManchester, United Kingdom
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
StipendFully Funded
Application DeadlineRolling
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

Basic Information

  • Full Project Title: Investigating the selective pressure for antimicrobial resistance under environmental factors
  • Host Institution: The University of Manchester & Peking University
  • Study Level: PhD (Dual Award)
  • Duration: 4 years (across Manchester and Beijing)
  • Start Date: January 2027
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Eligibility: Check with supervisor

Project Description

This interdisciplinary PhD project will investigate how environmental factors influence the evolution of antimicrobial resistance. At the University of Manchester, selected targets will be investigated experimentally using molecular biology, biochemical assays, and structural biology techniques.

Contact

  • Email: yi.jin@manchester.ac.uk

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be sent to the contacts above or raised through the channel given on the official announcement page.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://sites.manchester.ac.uk/amr-network/

Source: sites.manchester.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Rolling - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

About University of Manchester

The University of Manchester is a public research university in Manchester, England, and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across engineering, science, medicine, business and the humanities. Its research community connects academic discovery with challenges in health, sustainability, technology and society through collaboration.

Official website: https://www.manchester.ac.uk/

How to Apply

Contact Dr Yi Jin: yi.jin@manchester.ac.uk
